target: Field Track public synthetic manager dashboard

customReplacement.reason: The existing product dashboard was already the strongest proof surface. This pass preserved it, corrected the product contract, added shared footer components, and isolated MapLibre from the initial dashboard bundle.

contract.purpose: Explain and demonstrate a held, administrator-managed field-location system for continuously enrolled Android devices and freshness-aware route review.
contract.purposeSource: PRODUCT.md, PROJECT_STATUS.md, AGENTS.md, and the canonical Site Health project dossier
contract.canonicalPurpose: Field Track lets a manager locate employees carrying administrator-enrolled Android phones and review retained routes while tracking remains visible through Android's ongoing notification.
contract.driftNote: The older dossier described employee-controlled work-period sharing. Current repository contracts explicitly require continuous tracking after administrator enrollment with no employee start, stop, pause, or unenroll controls; the canonical catalog and generated SaaS Maker projection were corrected in this audit.
contract.audience: Managers of small field teams using managed, low-end Android phones in intermittent 4G conditions.
contract.job: Judge location freshness, inspect retained routes and gaps, understand device and retention state, and decide whether the held MVP merits economics and physical-device validation.
contract.thesis: The real synthetic manager dashboard is better product evidence than a separate marketing page when its managed-tracking boundary and held lifecycle are visible before the operational UI.
contract.system: Dense cream-and-forest operational surfaces, non-color status labels, accessible roster fallback, MapLibre map evidence, restrained warning amber, and shared Fleet footer components.
contract.signature: Freshness, route gaps, SIM health, and server retention are visible together without pretending synthetic data or untested Android delivery is production proof.
contract.risk: A polished dashboard could imply employee consent controls or production readiness, so the first viewport must state the continuous managed-tracking boundary, synthetic data, and unresolved economics and real-device testing.

projectCheck.note: Five server tests, Astro diagnostics, Android TypeScript checks, and the Cloudflare Worker build pass. Production-mode browser checks load the map worker and shared module without missing assets.

findings: Baseline independent review found two P1 truth defects: the page omitted the continuous administrator-managed tracking boundary and implied a generic coming-soon lifecycle. Both are resolved.
Residual P2: the operational mobile page is long because it preserves the full map, roster, selected-employee detail, and explicit product boundaries.
Residual P2: MapLibre remains a large deferred chunk, but it no longer inflates the initial dashboard bundle and its worker assets are explicitly available.

comprehension.reviewer: Independent fresh-visitor baseline and revised review by Harvey

answers.product: Field Track is a held manager system for continuous location tracking on administrator-enrolled Android devices.
answers.audience: It is for managers of small field teams using managed phones in weak-network conditions.
answers.value: It helps a manager find employees quickly and review retained routes, freshness, device state, and gaps.
answers.mechanism: The Android app tracks continuously after enrollment, keeps a visible notification, queues points through weak 4G, and lets server policy decide retention.
answers.proof: The real manager dashboard works with clearly labeled synthetic employees and routes; economics and physical Android testing remain unresolved.
answers.nextAction: Review the synthetic held MVP, then validate economics and a real Android device before onboarding or expansion.
